# Releases
## use-editable@3.0.0

### Major Changes

- [#40](https://github.com/FormidableLabs/use-editable/pull/40)
[`7097f72`](https://github.com/FormidableLabs/use-editable/commit/7097f72318d8c2ac8c366a6e160df92dea8d861c)
- Require React 18 or newer, and ship modern JavaScript.
  
- **Breaking:** the `react` peer dependency is now `>=18.0.0` (was
`>=16.8.0`).
- **Breaking:** `dist/` now targets ES2022 instead of ES5. Bundlers that
transpile `node_modules` for older browsers are unaffected.
- Types now live at `dist/use-editable.d.ts` (was
`dist/types/index.d.ts`); the `types` field points there, so normal
imports are unaffected. The `main` and `module` filenames are unchanged.
- The build moved from rollup, Babel, buble, closure-compiler and terser
to tsdown; releases are published from CI with npm provenance.

### Patch Changes

- [#37](https://github.com/FormidableLabs/use-editable/pull/37)
[`033a70c`](https://github.com/FormidableLabs/use-editable/commit/033a70cd746c5f869b3efeb4fbf27a792f82ee80)
- Don't restore a stale caret position onto content it wasn't computed
against. An unrelated re-render landing between a keystroke's `keydown`
and `keyup` no longer yanks the caret to the wrong offset.
